name: Ideogram 4.6
summary: Recolor a product to match your brand or touch up one part of a photo, with output up to 4K. Try it in the app or use the API, where edits start at $0.008.

name: TestSprite 4.0
summary: Describe how your web app should work and get browser tests you can rerun on each code change. Start free and review recordings of failed steps.

name: Genie 4 API
summary: Turn a prompt or reference image into a world you can explore and change as you go, with live sound. Try it in Google AI Studio or build it into your own prototype with the paid Gemini API.

name: Gemini 4 Neon
summary: Run long, tool-heavy coding agents and multi-file refactors on a frontier Gemini with a 1M-token context and adjustable thinking levels. Rolling out now in the Gemini API and AI Studio at $3/$15 per million tokens.

name: Clairic and Clairic-flash
summary: Pull structured data out of PDFs, images, and messy text, with confidence scores for every field. Open weights are on Hugging Face, or call them on Workers AI for $0.10 per million input tokens with output free.

name: Rumble-2-Flash
summary: Transcribe interviews or add captions in over 40 languages on your own machine. The downloadable model is free under Apache 2.0 and runs with Hugging Face Transformers.

name: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra
summary: Use Sol for everyday coding and Astra for longer projects that span code, documents, and research. Both are in Codex and ChatGPT Work on Plus and Pro, with Sol at one-quarter of Astra's API price per token.

name: llama.cpp 1.0
summary: Run open models like Kimi K3.1 Pro on your own machine, now with a stable 1.0 API, a redesigned local chat UI, and an OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech endpoint. Free and open source.
